contract: OPENCODE_PROJECT_TOOL_OUTPUT=1 changes only native text/binary output destinations to <Location.directory>/.legalwork/tool-output/<sessionID>/<native filename>. Native limits, previews, payloads, mixed content, pagination ownership and seven-day retention remain unchanged. Default OpenCode storage remains global. Chat folders only organize files; ordinary project permissions apply. Existing global retention still cleans legacy files.
